title: Ishqe Haider Jeet gaya
body:
Ishqe Haider Jeet gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider (A.s.).....
Ishk E Haider (A.s.).....Haider (A.s.).....Haider (A.s.)
Bekhatar Toot Pada Atish E Namrood (l.a.) Me Ishk
Zer E Khanjar Bhi Raha Sajda E Mabood Me Ishk
Ishk Chalta Hai Dahak Te Hue Angaron Par
Ishk Ki Aag Me Namrood Jhulaz Jaate Hai
Khak Ho Jaate Hai Jo Ishk Se Takrate Hai
Har Gai.....
Har Gai Sub Teer O Khanjar,ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Wah Re Kya Sardari Hai, Shahi Hamesh Hari Hai
Takht Shahi Ka Ho Gaya Pasta, Zikr Ali (a.s.) Ka Jari Hai
Ahle Sakifa.....
Ahle Sakifa Haar Gai Aur Khum Ka Mimbar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Kitne Dhamake Tumne Kiye, Phir Bhi Kahan Masoom Dare
Hasti Hai Khud Maut Bhi Tumpar, Bacchon Se Tum Har Gaie
Nade Ali (A.s.) Jo.....
Nade Ali (A.s.) Jo Sun Ke Piya Woh Sheer E Madar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Kismat Nasle Ummaiya Ki, Jeet Gaya Phir Ibne Adi
Rauza Jub Mismar Kiya To Lash Salamat Hi Nikli
Aao Mubarak.....
Aao Mubarak Baad De Usko, Phir Wahi Naukar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Sath Ali (A.s.) Ke Jaienga, Sue Jannat Matwala
Roienge Humpar Hasne Wale Jub Yeh Kahenga Unse Khuda
Shia Kafar.....
Shia Kafar Kehnewalon, Dekh Le Kafar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Nazim E Nazm E Mehfil Hai, Kurb  E Meesam Hasil hai
Zikr Ali (A.s.) Ka Karta Tha, Ab Zikr E Ali (A.s.) Me Shamil Hai
Har Gaie.....
Har Gai Sub Dushman E Haider (A.s.), Sibt E Jaafar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahle Sitam Ke Hosh Ude Usne Ki Tableegh Aaise
Haider (A.s.) Haider (A.s.) Haider (A.s.) Haider (A.s.) Mit Nahi Paaya
Dunia Se
Kehti Hai Yeh.....
Kehti Hai Yeh Sindh Ki Dharti Lal Qalandar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
<<DIVIDER>>
Shukr Ata Kar Madar Ka, Naukar Hai Tu Haider (A.s.) Ka
Tere Aqaide Ne Aai Takallum Kaam Kiya Hai Khanjar Ka
Jub Bhi Munafiq.....
Jub Bhi Munafiq Aaie Mukabil, Banda E Qambar Jeet Gaya
<<MINI>>
Ishk E Haider (A.s.) Jeet Gaya.....4
author: Mir Hassan Mir
